name: Lawn Almanac
author: jpenagg
description: For lawn lovers: pick your grass and town, and it works out your USDA zone and frost dates, then shows when to mow, soil temperature, rain, and what is next on the lawn calendar.

barWidget.description: Mowing weather, soil and rain, and a lawn calendar for your grass and climate.

schema.label: Weather lookups
schema.description: Fetch the forecast, town search results, and 30 years of climate history from open-meteo.com in the background. Off keeps the plugin fully offline: only the calendar is shown, following the zone you pick.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Send a notification when a lawn calendar job's window opens.

schema.label: Grass type
schema.description: Sets the mowing height, how growth is judged, and which jobs the lawn calendar shows.

schema.label: USDA hardiness zone
schema.description: Auto estimates the zone from 30 years of winter lows at the lawn's location. The zone is shown in the panel and checks that your grass suits it; it sets the calendar's dates only where frost dates are not available.

schema.label: Usual last spring frost, as MM-DD (blank to estimate)
Usual first fall frost, as MM-DD (blank to estimate)
